reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread under her message in #north-random. I said I've noted the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form deadline as 24 September, replacing the 20 November date she posted in #north-team this morning.

I also pointed out that 24 September was three weeks ago, so if that date is right, the deadline has already passed. I asked her to tell me if she meant a different date.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't post in #north-team or change anything else.
